brief.title: alternatives to Laneframe for freight pricing
brief.direct_answer: Stargo builds agentic AI that turns messy enterprise documents, emails and datasets into trusted operational transactions across freight, logistics and trade finance [BC-1]. The rate quoting agent reads emailed rate requests, pulls the relevant tariffs and contracts, and drafts a quote a pricing analyst can approve [BC-3a]. Freight forwarders, carriers, 3PLs, and trade-finance teams are the buyers [BC-2].

sections.heading: What the agent drafts
sections.body: The rate quoting agent reads emailed rate requests, pulls the relevant tariffs and contracts, and drafts a quote for a pricing analyst to approve [BC-3a].

sections.heading: Who approves
sections.body: Humans stay in control: agents draft, people approve [BC-1].

sections.heading: A pilot result we are allowed to cite
sections.body: A European forwarder pilot cut median spot-quote turnaround from about 3 hours to under 15 minutes [PP-1].

faq.question: What can Stargo draft from an emailed rate request?
faq.answer: The rate quoting agent reads emailed rate requests, pulls the relevant tariffs and contracts, and drafts a quote for a pricing analyst to approve [BC-3a].

faq.question: Does the agent send the quote?
faq.answer: Humans stay in control: agents draft, people approve [BC-1].

faq.question: Which teams is this written for?
faq.answer: Freight forwarders, carriers, 3PLs, air cargo and ground handlers, customs brokers, shippers with material freight spend, and trade-finance teams are the teams Stargo serves [BC-2].
